description: Creator memberships: plans (net.krao.membership.plan) in the creator's repo, payments (net.krao.membership.payment) in the member's repo, checked on Base by Krao's indexer.

priceUsdc.description: USDC base units (6 decimals) for 30 days.

active.description: False when the creator turned the plan off, or it is beyond the 3 active plans an account may have.

memberCount.description: Members whose current 30-day period was paid for with this plan.

plan.description: The plan of the current period (active), of the last one (expired), or of the payment being checked (pending, invalid).

status.description: 'active': paid up; 'expired': had paid, no longer; 'pending': a payment is being checked; 'invalid': the last payment was refused (see reason).

since.description: Start of the unbroken run of paid periods (active, expired), or when the payment was written (pending, invalid).

expiresAt.description: End of the paid periods (active, expired).

reason.description: Why the payment is pending or invalid.
